site: Tanore pilot point, medium-high land, irrigation available
calendarRule: Among the fixed calendar-feasible candidates, choose the shortest winter field occupancy; break ties by earlier Aman field release, then id. No weather, scores, income or outcome values are read.
nasaWaterRule: On the same feasible candidates, minimize training-period Aman rescue-irrigation frequency, then median winter net irrigation, then id. Freeze the chosen rotation before evaluating later seasons. This isolates a water-only policy; it is not the production seven-dimension ranking.
calendarSources: research/crops/brri_rice_varieties.csv: seedbed windows and durations; replay uses their midpoint plus seven turnaround days
research/explore/connect_check.py: fixed winter sowing dates and durations, not weather-derived phenology
limitations: Calendar feasibility checks field release before sowing and known sowing windows. Boro uses its recorded fixed transplanting date; the release has no Boro sowing window, so window suitability is unverified and reported separately.
The existing replay and its parameters were developed with knowledge of the broader historical period. This retrospective temporal split is not an untouched holdout or external validation.
Both policies are evaluated on the same NASA-driven simulation. These are modeled irrigation demands and rescue events, not observed water savings, yields, income or farmer decisions.
The calendar-only rule is one transparent simple comparator, not a reconstruction of an agricultural officer's advice. Common candidate identities were already chosen by the project.
No winter observations for 2025-26 exist in the checked-in replay table; that season is excluded rather than imputed.
This pilot comparison does not validate the haor, coast, all 544 upazilas, or the production seven-dimension recommendation. Land constraints, crop output and economic trade-offs are not scored here.
Aman rescue frequency is a count, not an irrigation volume. Winter net irrigation excludes Aman rescue water. No combined annual saving is inferred.
